caption: The drawing depicts a single revolver positioned horizontally on a plain, light beige background. The revolver has a brown wooden grip with visible grain texture and a metallic body featuring shades of grey and subtle blue highlights, suggesting a steel material. The hammer, trigger, cylinder, and barrel are all clearly defined, with the long barrel extending to the right side of the image. Several rivets and screws are visible on the gun's body. The barrel and cylinder display dark shading and reflections typical of metal surfaces. There is a signature reading "Elizabeth Johnson" located below and slightly to the right of the revolver. No additional objects or details are present in the composition.
title: Revolver
